categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies reindex block-index management to abort on an invalid genesis block body.
categories.rationale: Prevents an assertion failure or indefinite hang in RPC warmup when reindexing corrupted block files with an invalid genesis block body. The author notes that previously, "with -checkblockindex... it aborts on an assert in CheckBlockIndex. Without it, it stays in RPC warmup." While fixing a hang/crash on corrupted disk data improves reliability, it targets an uncommon edge case that is reasonably deferrable.
